{{Quote|A Hutt's home is where his business interests lie.''"<br />"''Even the members of the Trade Federation are not so mercenary.''"<br />"''Fine words, coming from the one whose organization covered up the niobarium pollution on Vorian Four.|[[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin]] and [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]|<ref name="TAS" />}}
'''Vorian Four''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="TAS" /> located within the [[Vorian system/Legends|Vorian system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was polluted with [[niobarium]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], but the incident was covered up by [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]].<ref name="TAS" />
